name: motion-graphics-studio
description: Make motion graphics and carousels in your own brand with Claude Code and HyperFrames: social videos (9:16, 4:5, 16:9), transparent overlays for talking-head video, and Instagram or LinkedIn carousels. Quick by default (say what you want, get a version, steer it), storyboards when you ask, critiques its own renders, keeps everything in plain files in your folder.
